name: Wheel of Heaven Divine-Council Index
description: An index of the divine council — the assembly of divine beings that governs and decides — across the ancient traditions: the presiding figure, the council term (in the original), the members, the function, and the primary reference, with links to the digitized texts. CC0 public domain.

rows.council_term: puḫru môʿidi / pḫr mʿd (“the assembled council”); bn ilm (“sons of El”)
rows.presiding_figure: El, the aged father of the gods
rows.members: The sons of El / the seventy sons of Athirat
rows.function: El presides while the assembly debates and confers kingship (Baal, Yam, Mot contend)

rows.council_term: ʿădat-ʾēl (“the divine council / assembly of El”)
rows.members: The ʾĕlōhîm (“gods”), judged for unjust rule and sentenced to “die like men”
rows.function: Judgment and demotion of the council gods

rows.members: The host of heaven, standing on his right and left
rows.function: Deliberation — a spirit volunteers as a “lying spirit” to entice Ahab

rows.members: The sons of God, with ha-śāṭān (“the Accuser”) among them
rows.function: The court presents itself; the wager over Job

rows.council_term: bənê ʾĕlōhîm / bənê ʾēl (“sons of God,” LXX & 4QDeut)
rows.members: The sons of God — one set over each nation; Yahweh's allotment is Israel
rows.function: Division of the nations among the council members
Commissioning — “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” (the council plural)

rows.council_term: puḫur ilāni (“the assembly of the gods”)
rows.function: The assembly grants Marduk kingship and the Tablet of Destinies to fight Tiamat
The assembly decrees the flood under oath — a decision Enki argues against

rows.council_term: The “Holy Ones” / the heavenly host before the throne
rows.presiding_figure: The Great Glory / the Lord of Spirits
rows.members: The Holy Ones; the Watchers (rebel members who descend)
rows.function: The heavenly court; the archangels petition; judgment on the Watchers

rows.council_term: The gods of heaven, in dynastic succession
rows.presiding_figure: The reigning sky-king (Alalu → Anu → Kumarbi → Teshub)
rows.function: The succession of divine kingship in heaven

rows.source_text: Book of Moses / Book of Abraham
rows.council_term: The “council in heaven”; the “noble and great ones”
rows.members: The premortal spirits / the noble and great ones
rows.function: The premortal council debates the plan and the choice of a Redeemer
